about_description: Tavo is a platform for easy and fast restaurant reservations. You can browse the best restaurants, read reviews, and book your favorite table with just one click.
contact_description: Contact us through any of the following channels and we will respond as soon as possible
faq_subtitle: Browse the frequently asked questions below
faq_1_question: How do I book a table?
faq_1_answer: Choose your favorite restaurant, then press the "Book" button. Select the date, time, and number of guests, then confirm the booking. You will receive a confirmation notification.
faq_2_answer: Yes, you can cancel your booking at least 4 hours before the scheduled time. Go to "Bookings" and press "Cancel Booking".
faq_3_question: How do I modify an existing booking?
faq_3_answer: Go to "Bookings" and tap on the booking you want to modify. Press "Edit" and change the date, time, or number of guests.
faq_4_answer: Yes, booking through the Tavo app is completely free. We do not charge any booking fees. Payment is made directly at the restaurant.
faq_5_question: How do I add a restaurant to favorites?
faq_5_answer: Tap the heart icon on the restaurant page to add it to your favorites list. You can access your favorites from the profile page.
faq_6_question: What should I do if I'm late for my booking?
faq_6_answer: Please contact the restaurant directly to inform them of the delay. Most restaurants hold reservations for 15 minutes after the scheduled time.
faq_7_question: How do I contact customer support?
faq_7_answer: You can contact us via email at support@tavo.app or via WhatsApp at +966 50 000 0000.
faq_8_question: Can I book for a large group?
faq_8_answer: Yes, you can book for groups of up to 20 people through the app. For larger groups, please contact the restaurant directly.
privacy_subtitle: We are committed to protecting your personal data
collecting_info_content: We collect personal information that you provide directly when creating an account or making a reservation, such as name, phone number, and email. We also collect automatic information such as IP address, device type, and operating system.
using_info_content: We use your information to provide and improve our services, including processing reservations, sending notifications and updates, personalizing your experience, and communicating with you about your account or our services.
sharing_info_content: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with partner restaurants to complete your reservations, and with service providers who help us operate the app.
security_info_content: We take reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction. We use encryption and standard security protocols.
your_rights_content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can also object to the processing of your data or request its transfer. To exercise these rights, please contact us.
cookies_content: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, analyze app usage, and provide personalized content. You can control cookie settings through your device settings.
children_privacy_content: Our services are not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn that we have collected information from a child, we will delete it immediately.
updates_content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes through an in-app notification or email. Your continued use of the app after the update constitutes acceptance of the changes.
terms_subtitle: Please read the terms carefully before using the app
accept_terms_content: By using the Tavo app, you agree to comply with these terms and conditions. If you do not agree to any of these terms, please do not use the app.
account_and_registration_content: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account information and for all activities that occur under your account.
bookings_terms_content: When making a reservation through the app, you commit to attending at the scheduled time. The restaurant reserves the right to cancel the reservation if you are more than 15 minutes late without prior notice.
cancellation_and_modification_content: You can cancel or modify your reservation at least 4 hours before the booking time. Frequent cancellations may affect your ability to make future reservations.
content_and_reviews_content: When posting a review or content, you grant us a non-exclusive license to use it. Content must be truthful and not infringe on the rights of others. We reserve the right to remove any violating content.
intellectual_property_content: All content, trademarks, and logos displayed in the app are the property of Tavo or partner restaurants. Copying or reproducing any content without prior written permission is prohibited.
liability_content: Tavo is an intermediary platform between you and restaurants. We are not responsible for the quality of food or service provided by restaurants. Any service-related disputes should be resolved directly with the restaurant.
account_termination_content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms. You can also delete your account at any time through the app settings.
modifications_content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. You will be notified of any material changes. Your continued use of the app constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
